title: 人体の構造と機能
subtitle: Structure and Function in Physiology
educationalGoal: Human Structure and Function majors can explain how the human body works, based on a deep understanding of the relationship between physiology and anatomy. This is the first course designed to provide foundational knowledge of the human body deemed necessary for discipline-specific courses in neuroscience and brain science. This course introduces not only the proximal factors, but also the ultimate factors of the mechanisms of the human body.
advice:
The structure of the organs and tissues that form the body of an animal when observed with an optical microscope is shown, and the organs are composed of various cells using the brain as a subject.
Explain the relationship between how it is built and its functions. If your brain health subsequently fails, for example, take dementia or Alzheimer's disease.
Raise and think about human life.
We will accept questions from students at any time and proceed in an interactive lecture format.
We will also provide an opportunity to announce the contents of the preparations and welcome active efforts.
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of chemistry, physics, and math is required. In order to understand the information presented, the habit of studying the background information is required.

activityGoals.body: Explain human structure and function from an evolutionary perspective.
Explain the structure and function of the human body, its organs, and tissues.
Explain human functions through signaling at the intracellular and intercellular levels.

              Human Structure and Function majors can explain how the human body works, based on a deep understanding of the relationship between physiology and anatomy. This is the first course designed to provide foundational knowledge of the human body deemed necessary for discipline-specific courses in neuroscience and brain science. This course introduces not only the proximal factors, but also the ultimate factors of the mechanisms of the human body.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The structure of the organs and tissues that form the body of an animal when observed with an optical microscope is shown, and the organs are composed of various cells using the brain as a subject.
Explain the relationship between how it is built and its functions. If your brain health subsequently fails, for example, take dementia or Alzheimer's disease.
Raise and think about human life.
We will accept questions from students at any time and proceed in an interactive lecture format.
We will also provide an opportunity to announce the contents of the preparations and welcome active efforts.
